summary: Placeholder has no accessible name, heading or live region; switching between placeholder subsections leaves identical unlabelled text, so screen-reader users cannot tell them apart
evidence: PlaceholderPage.svelte:9-11; VpnPage.svelte:16-17 and ComputerPage.svelte:11 reuse the same mounted placeholder for several subsections; related FND-0114
failure_scenario: VPN: Серверы then Маршруты: DOM unchanged, same В разработке text, no announcement.
